biggest_catch: You must route $5,000 in payroll/pension/government direct deposits into the account within 60 days AND keep a $5,000+ minimum balance for 90 days to reach the $400 tier; the $250 tier needs $2,500 of each. One new-account bonus per 2 years per product.
catches: Residents of OR, WA, CA, ID only.
Must not already have a Banner Bank personal checking account.
Not available to those whose Banner Bank accounts were closed within the last 2 years.
Only one new account opening-related bonus every 2 years on a personal checking account.
Direct deposit must be electronic paycheck, pension, or government benefits from employer/government; P2P payments, mobile check deposits, and micro-deposits do NOT qualify.
Must use promo code 2026EM at account opening.
Bonus paid within 30 days after requirements are met; account must be open and in good standing at payout.
Bonus is interest, reported on IRS Form 1099-INT/1042-S (taxable).
Minimum opening balance $25-$50 depending on checking account chosen; service fees may apply.
Offer may be changed or withdrawn without notice; offer expires 10/31/2026.

steps: Open a new Banner Bank personal checking account online at bannerbank.com or in a branch using promo code 2026EM at account opening.
Fund the account with the minimum opening balance ($25-$50 depending on account).
Within 60 days, complete ≥$2,500 (for $250 tier) or ≥$5,000 (for $400 tier) in qualifying direct deposits (electronic payroll, pension, or government benefits).
Maintain a minimum balance of $2,500 (for $250) or $5,000 (for $400) for 90 days.
Receive the bonus within 30 days after meeting all requirements; keep the account open and in good standing through payout.
timing: Bonus paid within 30 days after all requirements are met. Offer expires 10/31/2026 (38 days from check date).
